events.what_it_is: A two-day NYFW pop-up built around Calzedonia legwear, with beauty and hair touch-ups, a photo booth, coffee, branded stickers and on-site customization.
events.what_is_free: Public entry, coffee, branded stickers, hairstyle touch-ups and the photo booth are advertised as complimentary. Embroidery is free with purchase of the 20 Denier Hosiery Knee Highs; skincare sampling is also advertised.
events.caveats: Multiple current listings agree that the event is open to the public. The free embroidery is purchase-dependent, and samples or promotional items may be inventory-limited.
events.practical_notes: Saturday and Sunday, September 12-13, 12-5 PM at 188 Lafayette Street. No RSVP or approval requirement is published in the current listings.

events.what_it_is: A public pop-up for Estée Lauder's new Glimmer Eau de Parfum with fragrance discovery, photo moments, street treats and promotional gifts.
events.what_is_free: Public admission is free; current listings advertise treats, gifts and a chance to receive Estée Lauder product, but quantities are not guaranteed.
events.caveats: Current event listings agree that the pop-up is open to the public. Promotional product and gifts are chance- or inventory-dependent rather than guaranteed to every visitor.
events.practical_notes: Friday, September 11 from 12:30-7 PM and Saturday, September 12 from 11 AM-7 PM at 711 Greenwich Street. No advance RSVP or approval requirement is published.
